reviews.x: Wow, this toothpaste works great! First off, this is not a great tasting paste! Think concentrated mint & salt with a touch of pine. I was a heavy smoker for years & would typically drink a pot & half of coffee per day. My teeth were so yellow I would never smile & annual polishing did little to brighten my teeth. I tried Uncle Harry's & in about 2 weeks my wife commented on the change in my tooth color. Can't recommend highly enough!

reviews.x: I use this as a treatment 2x per week. It not only leaves my teeth feeling squeaky clean & polished but also really freshens my breath - even better than the most potent mouthwashes. If you are sensitive to commercial teeth whiteners, give this a try. This is my second jar - love it!

reviews.t: Tastes great but this is NOT toothpaste
reviews.x: This stuff tastes great and makes your mouth feel clean. However, I thought I was buying whitening toothpaste then noticed the container says to only use it 3 times per week. Either those are horrible guidelines for proper hygiene or apparently this is not tooth paste JUST tooth polish. A little misleading so I gave it 4 stars instead of 5.

reviews.t: Best Stuff in a little Jar, packing a powerful clean/whitening punch for the ole kisser.
reviews.x: I love it!  It cleans deeply and removes residual coffee and teas stains.  Your teeth feel like you've just come from the dentist, and coupled with my Oral B - it is one powerful, safe, wonderful way to get a deep cleaning to your teeth and gums.  I don't ever want to be without it.

claims.text: Reviewers widely report that the product effectively whitens teeth and removes coffee and tea stains.
Many reviewers praise how clean and polished their teeth feel after use.
Several reviewers complain about the small jar size relative to the price, with some calling it a ripoff or price gouging.
Some reviewers note the taste is unusual or polarizing, though others like it.
A few reviewers point out it is a polish meant for limited use (e.g., a few times per week) rather than a daily toothpaste.
